_doc: Stream E. Zone archetypes (PLAN §3.3): a content mix layered ON TOP of the floor every zone has (§3.4: a town + hamlets, 2+ farms, a fort, a dungeon door, 1-2 caves, 8-12 vignettes, a hook, a zone event boss, 2 rares, a treasure chain). Weights are relative odds the bake uses when it picks vignettes, monster families and extras; `extras` are what this archetype adds above the floor. M1 ships two in full (heartland, marsh); the other ten are named so vignette tags resolve, and get filled in at M2. Rule: neighbouring zones never share an archetype.

heartland.name: Heartland
heartland.feel: Rolling farmland and mills; the safe-looking country that brigands and beasts prey on.

marsh.name: Marsh
marsh.feel: Fen and mist, stilt hamlets, drowned chapels; lights in the reeds that are not lanterns.

crown_ring.name: Crown ring
crown_ring.feel: A walled city and its suburbs.

frontier.name: Frontier
frontier.feel: Contested border: a second fort, siege camps, burned farms.

wilds.name: Wilds
wilds.feel: Few people, the best treasure, beast dens.

ruinfield.name: Ruinfield
ruinfield.feel: One huge old ruin with extra dungeon doors.

lakeland.name: Lakeland
lakeland.feel: Lakes, ferries, fishing hamlets, a lake serpent.

blight.name: Blight
blight.feel: Corrupted ground held by a warband.

mine_country.name: Mine country
mine_country.feel: Hills and shafts, a mining town.
